evidence.title: Inside Trump’s Failed Hunt for Noncitizen Voters

occurrences.checkable_against: HSI personnel reassignment records
occurrences.quote_span: Starting in early 2025, Salisbury oversaw the unprecedented reassignment of more than 6,000 agents to immigration enforcement, diverting most of the agency from its normal duties .
occurrences.speaker: current and former agency officials
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Stearns County subpoena and voter-registration records
occurrences.quote_span: In Stearns County in central Minnesota, HSI agents subpoenaed voting histories on 13 people, county officials told ProPublica. Only six turned out to live there.
occurrences.speaker: Stearns County officials
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Minnesota U.S. attorney’s office referral records
occurrences.quote_span: After subpoenaing records on about 130 people, only one had been referred for prosecution, his staff had told him.
occurrences.speaker: Joe Teirab
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Minnesota U.S. attorney’s office referral records
occurrences.quote_span: As of May, only one illegal voting case has been referred for prosecution in Minnesota.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Congressional bill text and White House public statements
occurrences.quote_span: Trump has also continued to press Congress to enact the SAVE America Act , which would require people to provide proof of citizenship when registering to vote
occurrences.speaker: Donald Trump
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Justice Department national caseload data and federal court filings
occurrences.quote_span: Even fewer — 41 — were charged with voting illegally or other election-related crimes.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal prosecution records in the four states
occurrences.quote_span: Prosecutors have initiated a total of seven noncitizen voting cases as of May in the four states where DHS claimed to have found more than a quarter million noncitizens on the rolls.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: DOJ state data-sharing agreements and voter-roll files
occurrences.quote_span: For the 16 states that have agreed to share their unredacted voter lists, the DOJ had citizens’ partial Social Security numbers or driver’s license information, too.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: DHS released documents on voter-roll matches
occurrences.quote_span: To support that assertion, the Department of Homeland Security, HSI’s parent agency, released documents asserting it had found more than 250,000 noncitizens on voter rolls in just four states, all led by Democrats.
occurrences.speaker: Department of Homeland Security
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: White House appointment announcement and HSI personnel records
occurrences.quote_span: In December 2024, he named Anthony Salisbury, a 50-year-old career agent who’d run the agency’s Miami office, as a deputy homeland security adviser , reporting to White House policy chief Stephen Miller.
occurrences.speaker: Donald Trump
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: DHS documents asserting voter-roll totals
occurrences.quote_span: The documents included no explanation of how that number was calculated.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Ohio voter registration records
occurrences.quote_span: The state has nearly 8 million voters.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: HSI unit assignment and case-priority records
occurrences.quote_span: Another 15,000 were given to HSI’s cross-border financial crimes unit, which was told to prioritize them over money laundering and fraud cases, a former high-level HSI official said.
occurrences.speaker: former high-level HSI official
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: DHS announcement and state voter-list data
occurrences.quote_span: When DHS announced it had found more than 250,000 noncitizens on the registered voter lists of four Democrat-led states, it said that included “as many as” 35,152 in New Jersey and 14,576 in Pennsylvania.
occurrences.speaker: Department of Homeland Security
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Justice Department national caseload data
occurrences.quote_span: Between January 2025 and May 2026, a ProPublica analysis of Justice Department data shows, fewer than 150 alleged noncitizen voters were referred for prosecution.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: DOJ data and federal court filings
occurrences.quote_span: Through May, prosecutors had charged fewer than four dozen people with crimes related to noncitizen voting, ProPublica’s analysis of DOJ data and federal court filings shows, getting convictions or guilty pleas in 14 cases.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: HSI Innovation Lab analysis and New Jersey county voter records
occurrences.quote_span: According to one former HSI official, they said they’d found “5,000 high-confidence illegal voters” in just a single New Jersey county.
occurrences.speaker: former HSI official
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: HSI Innovation Lab meeting records and emails
occurrences.quote_span: In early July 2025, Frank Quiñones, an HSI special agent who’d worked under Salisbury in Florida, approached leaders at the HSI Innovation Lab with an idea for using the agency’s technology to find noncitizen voters on state voter rolls, sources at the agency told ProPublica.
occurrences.speaker: ProPublica sources at HSI
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: DHS response to ProPublica and HSI data-processing records
occurrences.quote_span: The agency wouldn’t specify what tools or techniques HSI had used, but confirmed it had cross-referenced “publicly available data” from state voter rolls with information on “known illegal aliens” in its systems.
occurrences.speaker: DHS spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal prosecution and referral data for Ohio
occurrences.quote_span: As of May, just two voting cases had been referred for prosecution in Ohio and no one had been charged, federal data shows.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: SAVE and HSI case-lead records
occurrences.quote_span: About 25,000 of them involved people SAVE had identified as potential noncitizens on state voter rolls.
occurrences.speaker: former high-level HSI official
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: HSI emails and assignment records
occurrences.quote_span: At least nine HSI agents in Cincinnati and Cleveland began to investigate, emails obtained by Campaign Legal Center and shared with ProPublica show.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Annual government report on wiretaps
occurrences.quote_span: According to an annual government report , the number of wiretaps obtained by DHS — often to investigate drug trafficking — plummeted to 23 in 2025, from 133 the previous year.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: CREW v. federal government complaint and court docket
occurrences.quote_span: CREW filed a lawsuit in April on behalf of the nonprofit advocacy group Common Cause that argues it’s illegal for the administration to use the law enforcement exception to justify mass sharing of voter information.
occurrences.speaker: Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Final data-sharing letter signed by Todd Lyons and DOJ records
occurrences.quote_span: The final letter, signed by Lyons and sent to the DOJ just two days later, abandoned even that limitation.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Final DOJ-DHS data-sharing letter
occurrences.quote_span: Just three paragraphs long, it permitted HSI to use the voter rolls to pursue any “appropriate investigation of potential violations of federal election law.”
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations

occurrences.checkable_against: Ohio secretary of state referral records
occurrences.quote_span: In October, the Ohio secretary of state referred more than 1,000 voters identified as possible noncitizens to the federal government, claiming 167 had voted at least once since 2018.
occurrences.speaker: Ohio secretary of state
occurrences.subject: Homeland Security Investigations
